name: What should I do before demolition starts?

mainEntity.name: What should I do before demolition starts on a kitchen remodel to avoid delays?
mainEntity.text: What should I do before demolition starts on a kitchen remodel to avoid delays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before demolition starts, homeowners should make sure the scope is locked, materials are ordered, and all critical selections are approved. Cabinets, countertops, appliances, fixtures, and tile should be confirmed as early as possible so the project does not stall later. The kitchen and adjacent areas should be cleared, valuables removed, and dust protection discussed with the contractor. It is also important to verify permit status, inspection timing, and any utility shutoff plan before work begins. If the remodel includes keeping or reusing items, those decisions should be documented in writing. The more decisions made before demo, the fewer expensive delays and change orders will occur once construction is underway. A pre-demolition checklist helps the remodel start cleanly and keeps the schedule realistic from day one.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before demolition starts, finalize the scope, confirm materials, clear the kitchen, protect nearby rooms, and verify permits and utility shutoff plans. Any unresolved decisions should be handled before demo so the project does not stop in the middle of construction.
